The Second Division promotion race is heating up, with 올덤 애슬레틱 still top of the table and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 having crept up to second place. 셰필드 웬즈데이 occupy the third and final automatic promotion place. 밀월 , 울버햄프턴 원더러스 , 반즐리 and 미들즈브러 have all climbed into the playoff zone this month. 찰턴 애슬레틱 are in real danger of a second successive relegation as they occupy second from bottom place in the Second Division with eight defeats from their opening 13 games. The Football League Cup third round action includes a Mick Harford hat-trick for 더비 카운티 in a 6–0 home win over his old club 선덜랜드. 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 리버풀 3–1 at Old Trafford . 노팅엄 포리스트 keep their hopes of a third successive League Cup triumph alive with a 2–1 win at Plymouth .
